_doc: Trend wake-up (owner 2026-11-22, from RELIANCE 15m phase_patterns): choppiness drops fast, volume wakes up, often after a small dip. Each variant = DSL entry WITHOUT the liquidity floor (added automatically). Exits: fixed % target/stop, held overnight. Checked by: python -m stock_gplm.app.pattern_check --spec config/research/wakeup_15m.json --symbol RELIANCE
name: TrendWakeUp

variants.ChopDropVolDip: chop(14) - chop(14)[3] < -5 and slot_rvol(20) >= 1.25 and close < close[3]
variants.ChopDropVolLowMfi: chop(14) - chop(14)[3] < -5 and slot_rvol(20) >= 1.25 and mfi(14) < 53
variants.ChopDropVolSurgeLowMfi: chop(14) - chop(14)[3] < -5 and mfi(14) < 53 and (slope(volume, 5) - slope(volume, 5)[3]) / max(sma(volume, 20), 1) >= 0.6
